# AiNews247 - AI News Aggregation Platform

Site Owner: mohd.ali.el@gmail.com

AiNews247 automatically curates the latest artificial intelligence and technology news from trusted sources including Hacker News, TechCrunch, Ars Technica, Wired, and more. Our AI-powered filtering ensures you only see the most relevant and important stories in the rapidly evolving world of AI and technology.

Why we need your data: We use Google OAuth for secure authentication and may access your Google Drive (with your permission) to help you save and organize important articles. Your privacy is protected - we never sell your data.
